AUTHORITY: PRIMARY OFFICIAL
SOURCE: amended_irr_bp_344_official_gazette_2.pdf | pages 25-31 and 52 | Appendix A, 7. Signage and Wayfinding; 6.19
CANONICAL FACTS:
- Signage shall use contrasting colors and a minimum luminance contrast of 30% from its surroundings.
- Graphic, text, and Braille signage on walls and doors shall be installed at a maximum height of 1500 mm from the finished floor to the center of the sign.
- Door-mounted signage for accessible toilets and showers shall be 200 mm x 200 mm. Wall and door-mounted signs shall generally be not less than 200 mm x 200 mm.
- Signage shall incorporate graphics, text, and Braille. Tactile symbols, letters, or numbers shall be embossed with a minimum height of 1 mm.
- Tactile floor surfaces shall be situated at a minimum clear width of 600 mm away from tripping hazards, walls, columns, and other confusing elements.
- Tactile floor surfaces shall have a minimum luminance contrast of 50% from adjacent floor finishes.
- Table A.7.2 establishes these tactile block dimensions: all block types are 300 mm x 300 mm; directional tactile blocks use parallel raised bars 34 mm wide and 5 mm high; warning tactile blocks use truncated domes in a square grid 35 mm in diameter and 5 mm high; positional tactile blocks use truncated domes in a staggered arrangement 23 mm in diameter and 5 mm high.
- Warning tactile blocks shall have a depth of 600 mm and a 300 mm setback before hazards or target objects such as staircases, escalators, ramps, control panels, and tactile information maps.
- Raised tactile letters and numerals shall be 0.75 mm high, upper case, and accompanied with Grade 2 Braille. Raised characters shall be at least 16 mm high but no higher than 50 mm.
- Visible alarms or strobes in accessible toilet compartments shall flash not more than 2 flashes per second and shall comply with the latest Fire Code of the Philippines and NFPA 72 provisions.
USE RULES:
- Use this card as the primary anchor for BP 344 (2024 IRR) tactile blocks, Braille signage, and visual-alarm topics.
- Do not import older thresholds or alternative tactile dimensions unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL source in the provided context explicitly states them.
